    Bricks #

    Library conventions: A is a k-algebra and modules are left A-modules with a compatible k-structure. Right modules over Λ are modules over A = Λᵐᵒᵖ.

    • IsBrick: a nonzero module whose nonzero endomorphisms are invertible.
    • Over an algebraically closed field, a finite-dimensional brick has endomorphisms k · id (IsBrick.exists_eq_smul_id), and conversely a nonzero module with at most one-dimensional endomorphism space is a brick.
    • IsBrick.hom_eq_zero_of_ne_zero: equation (2.1) of the manuscript; a simple module cannot lie in both the top and the socle of a nonsimple brick.
    • IsBrick.of_surjective_of_projective: Lemma 2.3.
